rows.text: Un danno o un segno di effrazione può indicare un accesso non autorizzato, anche se lieve; da solo non prova che qualcuno sia ancora a bordo.
evidence: UK Home Office, Clandestine entrant civil penalty scheme, sections “If you suspect someone is hiding in your vehicle” and “At UK border control”, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/clandestine-entrant-civil-penalty-scheme : damage or tampering may indicate access; contact police and do not approach; guidance for UK journeys.

rows.text: Una serratura del vano di carico rotta può rivelare un accesso non autorizzato: è un indizio da verificare, non la prova della presenza di una persona.
evidence: UK Home Office, Clandestine entrant civil penalty scheme, sections “If you suspect someone is hiding in your vehicle” and “At UK border control”, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/clandestine-entrant-civil-penalty-scheme : damage or tampering may indicate access; contact police and do not approach; guidance for UK journeys.

rows.text: L’azienda organizza e comunica ai conducenti le procedure di controllo e segnalazione: lasciarli senza indicazioni vanifica il sistema di sicurezza.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, RTSS toolkit, section 6.1 Vehicle security, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/meeting-the-road-transport-security-standards/how-to-meet-the-standards-an-rtss-toolkit-for-commercial-vehicle-operators : checks, reporting protocols, alarms and secure, illuminated parking; UK guidance.

rows.text: Lucchetti e sigilli servono invece a proteggere il vano di carico dagli accessi non autorizzati; vanno controllati per individuare eventuali manomissioni.
evidence: UK Home Office, Clandestine entrant penalty scheme: check and secure your vehicle, sections “Resealing your trailer” and “Final checks”, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/clandestine-entrant-penalty-scheme-check-and-secure-your-vehicle/clandestine-entrant-penalty-scheme-check-and-secure-your-vehicle : locks or seals secure cargo; report suspected access; UK scheme.

UK Department for Transport, RTSS toolkit, section 6.1 Vehicle security, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/meeting-the-road-transport-security-standards/how-to-meet-the-standards-an-rtss-toolkit-for-commercial-vehicle-operators : checks, reporting protocols, alarms and secure, illuminated parking; UK guidance.

rows.text: Il sospetto va segnalato alle autorità; abbandonare subito il veicolo non è la procedura indicata. Non avvicinarsi a chi potrebbe essere nascosto a bordo.
evidence: UK Home Office, Clandestine entrant civil penalty scheme, sections “If you suspect someone is hiding in your vehicle” and “At UK border control”, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/clandestine-entrant-civil-penalty-scheme : damage or tampering may indicate access; contact police and do not approach; guidance for UK journeys.

rows.text: Dieci minuti non sono una soglia sicura: anche una breve sosta incustodita può consentire un accesso. Occorre mettere in sicurezza il veicolo e controllarlo.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, RTSS toolkit, section 6.1 Vehicle security, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/meeting-the-road-transport-security-standards/how-to-meet-the-standards-an-rtss-toolkit-for-commercial-vehicle-operators : checks, reporting protocols, alarms and secure, illuminated parking; UK guidance.

rows.text: In specifiche operazioni contro l’immigrazione irregolare, con fondati motivi, la polizia può controllare mezzi e cose trasportate anche se soggetti a regime doganale speciale. Il potere ha condizioni e limiti territoriali.
evidence: Gazzetta Ufficiale, supplemento ordinario n. 26, 29 July 2020, D.Lgs. 286/1998 art. 12(7), https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/gu/2020/07/29/189/so/26/sg/pdf : inspections including goods under special customs regimes during specified operations against irregular immigration in border provinces and territorial waters, on founded grounds; scope of quiz inferred from its context.

rows.text: Affrontare un rapinatore armato può mettere in pericolo la vita. Proteggiti e avvisa la polizia appena puoi farlo in sicurezza.
evidence: TAPA EMEA, Driver Security Guide v1.0, 12 June 2024, pp. 6–7, https://tapaemea.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/TAPA-EMEA-Driver-Security-Guide-English.pdf : plan secure parking, call police, do not confront criminals, report incident details.

rows.text: La polizia può intervenire e raccogliere gli elementi utili: avvisala appena puoi farlo in sicurezza.
evidence: TAPA EMEA, Driver Security Guide v1.0, 12 June 2024, pp. 6–7, https://tapaemea.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/TAPA-EMEA-Driver-Security-Guide-English.pdf : plan secure parking, call police, do not confront criminals, report incident details.

rows.text: Non bisogna escludere l’intervento della polizia: la segnalazione permette di attivare i soccorsi e raccogliere informazioni sul fatto.
evidence: TAPA EMEA, Driver Security Guide v1.0, 12 June 2024, pp. 6–7, https://tapaemea.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/TAPA-EMEA-Driver-Security-Guide-English.pdf : plan secure parking, call police, do not confront criminals, report incident details.

rows.text: Veicoli e carichi sono bersagli della criminalità nel trasporto su strada: proteggere entrambi e scegliere soste sicure riduce l’esposizione.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, RTSS toolkit, section 6.1 Vehicle security, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/meeting-the-road-transport-security-standards/how-to-meet-the-standards-an-rtss-toolkit-for-commercial-vehicle-operators : checks, reporting protocols, alarms and secure, illuminated parking; UK guidance.

National Business Crime Centre and NaVCIS, Cargo Crime Prevention, paragraphs “Cargo at rest is cargo at risk” and “Remember the basics”, https://nbcc.police.uk/news/nbcc-teams-up-with-navcis-on-cargo-crime-prevention : cargo crime, vehicle security and parking risk in UK data.

rows.text: Un antifurto o immobilizzatore aggiunge una barriera contro la sottrazione del veicolo; va attivato quando il mezzo è incustodito.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, RTSS toolkit, section 6.1 Vehicle security, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/meeting-the-road-transport-security-standards/how-to-meet-the-standards-an-rtss-toolkit-for-commercial-vehicle-operators : checks, reporting protocols, alarms and secure, illuminated parking; UK guidance.

rows.text: Anche il conducente può subire una rapina durante il trasporto: i beni non valgono il rischio di affrontare gli aggressori.
evidence: TAPA EMEA, Driver Security Guide v1.0, 12 June 2024, pp. 6–7, https://tapaemea.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/TAPA-EMEA-Driver-Security-Guide-English.pdf : plan secure parking, call police, do not confront criminals, report incident details.

rows.text: Conoscere i punti a rischio aiuta a pianificare il percorso e le soste in aree più sicure prima di partire.
evidence: National Business Crime Centre and NaVCIS, Cargo Crime Prevention, paragraphs “Cargo at rest is cargo at risk” and “Remember the basics”, https://nbcc.police.uk/news/nbcc-teams-up-with-navcis-on-cargo-crime-prevention : plan secure stops, avoid dark secluded sites; report crime; UK cargo-crime data.

TAPA EMEA, Driver Security Guide v1.0, 12 June 2024, pp. 6–7, https://tapaemea.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/TAPA-EMEA-Driver-Security-Guide-English.pdf : plan secure parking, call police, do not confront criminals, report incident details.

rows.text: Un luogo isolato offre meno sorveglianza: per la sosta scegli, quando possibile, un’area sicura e non appartata.
evidence: National Business Crime Centre and NaVCIS, Cargo Crime Prevention, paragraphs “Cargo at rest is cargo at risk” and “Remember the basics”, https://nbcc.police.uk/news/nbcc-teams-up-with-navcis-on-cargo-crime-prevention : plan secure stops, avoid dark secluded sites; report crime; UK cargo-crime data.

UK Department for Transport, RTSS toolkit, section 6.1 Vehicle security, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/meeting-the-road-transport-security-standards/how-to-meet-the-standards-an-rtss-toolkit-for-commercial-vehicle-operators : checks, reporting protocols, alarms and secure, illuminated parking; UK guidance.

rows.text: Una zona ben illuminata rende più visibili persone e attività; insieme a sorveglianza e altre protezioni aiuta a scegliere una sosta più sicura.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, RTSS toolkit, section 6.1 Vehicle security, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/meeting-the-road-transport-security-standards/how-to-meet-the-standards-an-rtss-toolkit-for-commercial-vehicle-operators : checks, reporting protocols, alarms and secure, illuminated parking; UK guidance.

National Business Crime Centre and NaVCIS, Cargo Crime Prevention, paragraphs “Cargo at rest is cargo at risk” and “Remember the basics”, https://nbcc.police.uk/news/nbcc-teams-up-with-navcis-on-cargo-crime-prevention : plan secure stops, avoid dark secluded sites; report crime; UK cargo-crime data.

rows.text: Evitare una risposta violenta riduce il rischio di escalation per conducente e passeggeri. Si può comunque chiedere aiuto e segnalare il comportamento.
evidence: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control measures to prevent violence and aggression, section “De-escalation”, https://www.hse.gov.uk/violence/employer/controls-to-prevent.htm : calm situations and avoid arguing or raising voice.

TAPA EMEA, Driver Security Guide v1.0, 12 June 2024, pp. 6–7, https://tapaemea.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/TAPA-EMEA-Driver-Security-Guide-English.pdf : plan secure parking, call police, do not confront criminals, report incident details.

rows.text: La prevenzione delle rapine non autorizza automaticamente a portare un’arma: il porto fuori casa è soggetto a restrizioni e autorizzazioni. Esporla sul cruscotto non è una misura ordinaria di sicurezza.
evidence: Gazzetta Ufficiale, 11 May 2026, coordinated Decree-Law, reproduction of Law 110/1975 art. 4, https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/atto/serie_generale/caricaArticoloDefault/originario?atto.codiceRedazionale=26A02297&atto.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=2026-05-11&atto.tipoProvvedimento=TESTO+COORDINATO+DEL+DECRETO-LEGGE : carrying weapons outside home is prohibited subject to specified authorizations.

rows.text: Un luogo non isolato offre più possibilità di sorveglianza; è preferibile scegliere anche un’area illuminata e protetta.
evidence: National Business Crime Centre and NaVCIS, Cargo Crime Prevention, paragraphs “Cargo at rest is cargo at risk” and “Remember the basics”, https://nbcc.police.uk/news/nbcc-teams-up-with-navcis-on-cargo-crime-prevention : plan secure stops, avoid dark secluded sites; report crime; UK cargo-crime data.

UK Department for Transport, RTSS toolkit, section 6.1 Vehicle security, https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/meeting-the-road-transport-security-standards/how-to-meet-the-standards-an-rtss-toolkit-for-commercial-vehicle-operators : checks, reporting protocols, alarms and secure, illuminated parking; UK guidance.

rows.text: Rispondere alla provocazione con violenza può aggravare il conflitto. Mantieni la calma e cerca aiuto se necessario.
evidence: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control measures to prevent violence and aggression, section “De-escalation”, https://www.hse.gov.uk/violence/employer/controls-to-prevent.htm : calm situations and avoid arguing or raising voice.

rows.text: Orario, luogo, modalità e descrizioni utili aiutano la polizia a ricostruire l’accaduto e a indagare.
evidence: TAPA EMEA, Driver Security Guide v1.0, 12 June 2024, pp. 6–7, https://tapaemea.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/TAPA-EMEA-Driver-Security-Guide-English.pdf : plan secure parking, call police, do not confront criminals, report incident details.

rows.text: Le zone isolate e poco illuminate offrono meno sorveglianza e rendono più facile agire senza essere notati. Per le soste è preferibile scegliere aree sicure, illuminate e frequentate.
evidence: Commissione europea, ROADSEC Security Guidance (2019), sez. 2.5, pp. 17–18, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/document/download/4dcd1d96-d190-42d9-948a-bb1fe34c2554_en?filename=roadsec-abridged-version_en.pdf: raccomanda soste sicure e illuminate, evitando aree isolate, buie e con pochi camion; la guida tratta il rischio di furto del carico, non quantifica le rapine.

Commissione europea, Final Report MOVE/C1/SER/2023-138 (2025), sez. 5.3.1, pp. 60–61, https://www.europarl.europa.eu/meetdocs/2024_2029/plmrep/COMMITTEES/TRAN/DV/2025/06-24/Final-Report-SSPAs_MOVEC1SER2023-138_EN.pdf: descrive furti di carico in aree non protette e violenze compresi dirottamenti; non quantifica le rapine per tipo di sosta o bersaglio.

rows.text: Le aree custodite sono scelte proprio per proteggere conducente e carico; il rischio riguarda in particolare le soste in aree prive di sicurezza. La custodia riduce il rischio, senza eliminarlo.
evidence: Commissione europea, ROADSEC Security Guidance (2019), sez. 2.5, pp. 17–18, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/document/download/4dcd1d96-d190-42d9-948a-bb1fe34c2554_en?filename=roadsec-abridged-version_en.pdf: raccomanda soste sicure e illuminate, evitando aree isolate, buie e con pochi camion; la guida tratta il rischio di furto del carico, non quantifica le rapine.
